en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a panoramic view over a hillside town and surrounding plain with mountains in the distance. In the middle ground there is a long complex of light-colored buildings with towers or tall sections, possibly part of a monastery or institutional complex. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the place, and handwritten Greek text appears along the bottom margin. The style is typical of early 20th‑century view postcards.
